title: Troubleshooting
content:
# Troubleshooting

Fixes for the common problems when connecting Zernio to an AI assistant or the CLI, from sign-in errors to accounts that need reconnecting.

## The assistant says "No accounts connected"

Sign-in worked, but no social account is connected yet. Connect one in the [Zernio app](https://zernio.com), then ask again.

## Claude says "Couldn't reach the MCP server"

Remove the connector and add it again. Claude remembers a failed sign-in until you re-add it.

## "Couldn't register with Zernio's sign-in service"

Usually a temporary hiccup. Remove the server or connector and add it again.

Still failing? Check [status.zernio.com](https://status.zernio.com).

## 401 Unauthorized

Your sign-in expired or was revoked.

- **Assistant:** remove the server and add it again to sign in fresh.
- **CLI:** run `zernio auth:login`.

## Changes don't show up

After editing your assistant's MCP settings, quit and reopen it completely.

## A post failed

Ask your assistant "Why did my last post fail?" or run `zernio posts:get <id>`.

The most common cause is an account that needs reconnecting. Reconnect it in the Zernio app, then ask the assistant to retry.

## It picked the wrong account

Name the account in your request ("post from @acme"). With several accounts on one platform, the assistant asks instead of guessing.

## Still stuck?

- [Status page](https://status.zernio.com)
- [Telegram community](https://t.me/zernio_dev)
